text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш kneels before me and her
parents to
show her respect and
admiration after taking first
place at the
Tokyo Racecourse—the very same
track
where she won the Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her parents are thrilled with her victory
and tell
her how proud they are.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her goal achieved, Эйсин Флэш is filled
with
excitement for her final
challenge—the Arima
Kinen. And
although I, too, am excited...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...I decide to draft up a schedule for her
that
extends past the Arima Kinen in the
hope that
she'll continue to run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
